cards.locator: The Everything Room, paragraph describing existing IKEA desk and simultaneous work
cards.condition: Multiple continuing activities need separate usable work surfaces; existing useful furniture retained.
cards.reported_decision: An existing desk and an added window desk coexist for two simultaneous workers.
cards.permissible_transfer: Prefer a separate work allocation when the existing table still has a required use.
cards.excluded_transfer: No exact L shape, window pose, capacity, target coordinates or historical action supervision.

cards.locator: Architect-supplied text, long-term young-family rental and three retained bedrooms
cards.condition: Continuing family bedroom needs in a long-term rental.
cards.reported_decision: Three existing bedrooms retained while shared areas were reorganized.
cards.permissible_transfer: Check continuing sleeping needs before reassigning a bedroom.
cards.excluded_transfer: Do not convert this observed strategy into a universal prohibition on removing an explicitly unneeded bed.
